# Jarvex – End-to-End Digital Growth Agency

> Jarvex (jarvex.in) is a digital services agency based in India. We help businesses build, grow, and scale their online presence through website design & hosting, Google & Meta Ads management, mobile app development, and AI integrations. Contact: info@jarvex.in | +91 99495 01828.

## Services

- [Website Design & Hosting](https://jarvex.in/services): Custom, mobile-first websites with domain registration, hosting with SSL, on-page SEO, blog setup, WhatsApp integration, contact forms, and GA4 analytics. Optional e-commerce with product uploads and payment gateway. Delivered in 7–25 days depending on package.
- [Google & Meta Ads Management](https://jarvex.in/services): End-to-end performance marketing — Google Search, Display & YouTube campaigns, plus Facebook & Instagram (Meta) advertising. Covers audience targeting, retargeting, A/B testing, creative refresh, and weekly reporting.
- [Mobile App Development](https://jarvex.in/services): iOS and Android native apps and cross-platform development using Flutter and React Native. Covers discovery, UI/UX design, development, QA, App Store submission, and post-launch support. Progressive Web Apps (PWA) also available.
- [AI Integrations](https://jarvex.in/services): Custom AI-powered chatbots, business automation workflows, LLM fine-tuning, and AI-assisted product features embedded directly into websites and business systems.

## Pricing Packages (Website Design)

- [Starter Package](https://jarvex.in/pricing): 1–5 page website. Includes domain (1 yr), hosting with SSL (1 yr), mobile responsive design, basic SEO, blog setup, contact forms, WhatsApp integration, GA4 + Google Tag Manager setup. Delivery: 7–10 days.
- [Growth Package](https://jarvex.in/pricing): 5–10 page website. Everything in Starter plus advanced speed optimisation, advanced SEO setup (5 pages), and 5 initial blog uploads. Delivery: 10–15 days.
- [E-Commerce Package](https://jarvex.in/pricing): 10–20 page online store. Everything in Growth plus full e-commerce functionality, up to 25 product uploads, payment gateway, advanced SEO (10 pages), and 10 blog uploads. Delivery: 15–25 days.
- Performance marketing (Google & Meta Ads), mobile app development, and AI services are custom-quoted — contact Jarvex directly for pricing.

## How Jarvex Works (4-Step Process)

See full details: [https://jarvex.in/process](https://jarvex.in/process)

1. **Discover** – Deep-dive briefing covering business goals, target audience, competitors, and brand identity. Scope, timeline, and success metrics are agreed before any work begins.
2. **Design** – Wireframing, brand alignment, and user-experience design. Every layout decision is driven by both aesthetics and conversion intent.
3. **Build** – Full development, content integration, quality assurance, and testing across all devices and browsers.
4. **Launch** – Live deployment, analytics and tracking setup, and complete credential handoff. Post-launch support ensures everything runs smoothly.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does every Jarvex website package include?**
All packages include domain registration (1 year), hosting with SSL (1 year), mobile responsive design, SEO setup, blog setup, WhatsApp integration, contact forms, and GA4/Google Tag Manager setup. No hidden costs.

**How quickly can Jarvex build a website?**
Starter: 7–10 days. Growth: 10–15 days. E-Commerce: 15–25 days. Timelines begin after the discovery call and content handoff.

**Who owns the website after delivery?**
All assets, content, credentials, and source code are fully the client's. Jarvex hands over everything at project delivery.

**Does Jarvex run Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns?**
Yes. Jarvex provides end-to-end management of Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube) and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) for businesses across India and internationally.

**Does Jarvex develop mobile apps?**
Yes. Jarvex builds iOS and Android apps — native and cross-platform (Flutter, React Native, PWA) — from concept and design through to App Store launch.

**Does Jarvex offer AI services?**
Yes. Jarvex integrates custom AI solutions including chatbots, automation workflows, LLM-based tools, and AI-powered features into websites and business systems.

**Can I add more pages or features after launch?**
Absolutely. Extra pages and product uploads can be added at any time. Contact Jarvex for details based on your package.

**What happens after the first year (domain/hosting)?**
Domain and hosting renewals are billed annually at standard rates. All website assets remain fully yours.

**What industries does Jarvex serve?**
Jarvex works with startups, SMEs, and established businesses across all industries in India and internationally.

## About Jarvex

Jarvex is a full-service digital agency focused on business outcomes, not just deliverables. Founded in India, the team delivers measurable digital growth for clients ranging from early-stage startups to established brands. Core philosophy: be a growth engine, not just an agency.
